scripts.setup: npm i && anchor run link-keys && anchor build && npm run wasm
scripts.wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-pack build crates/bindings --target bundler --out-dir $PWD/packages/wasm-lib && npm pkg set name='@calma/wasm-lib' --prefix packages/wasm-lib
scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run --workspace @calma/app build
